values.binNote: Per-tick values are per-0.5s tick, computed as half of AuraDamagePerSecond's per-second rate: bin's AuraDamagePerSecond is [60/150/240] with +0.1x ap and +0.1x bonus ad per second, halved per 0.5s tick gives base [30/75/120] with 0.05 ratios; wiki lists per-rank base as 30/60/90/120 (4 values, not 3), which does not match the 3-rank ultimate structure in the bin (HealthGain and AuraDamagePerSecond both have 3 entries) - likely a wiki formatting artifact treating this as a 5-step ap range rather than 3 ranks.
This is a derived total (per-tick times 30 ticks over the 15s duration) and restates r_2; kept per instructions only because it aggregates useful total-damage info, but no bin row directly states it.

mechanics.claim: Dominus' cooldown is not refunded if Renekton dies during the cast animation.
mechanics.quote: ''Dominus' ''{{sti|cooldown}} is not refunded if '''Renekton''' {{tip|death|dies}} during the cast animation.

mechanics.claim: Renekton continually generates Fury while Dominus is active, up to a cap of 75.
mechanics.quote: generates {{as|5 Fury}} per second, up to a maximum of {{as|75 Fury}}

mechanics.claim: Dominus deals magic damage to nearby enemies every 0.5 seconds for its duration.

mechanics.claim: Dominus' bonus health gain does not interact with Spirit Visage or Grievous Wounds, and is retained (if not over normal max) after the buff ends.
